plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says there definitely are shafts running beneath the Great Sphinx at Giza in Egypt. He adds that even Zahi Hawass, Egypt's best-known archaeologist and a symbol of the official view, has admitted it, which to Michels suggests the ancient site holds more than we have been told.
